SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.cata_name), ''), '기타문서') AS category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.code_name), ''), '-') AS division_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), 'ANYTIME') AS reg_term, COALESCE(cci.item_nm, NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), 'ANYTIME') AS reg_term_nm, '관리자 외 2명' AS assignee_summary FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ccg ON ccg.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ccg.group_code = 'WF_FORM_CYCLE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item cci ON cci.group_id = ccg.common_code_group_id AND cci.item_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), 'ANYTIME') WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.use_at, 'N') = 'Y'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(w.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(w.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END, w.drafting_work_category_id
